parts.html: The K-31 kitchen is a modern two-tone L-shaped kitchen: light lime-green wall cabinets and brown wood-effect lower fronts. The light green on top looks fresh, and the warm wood below balances it.
The lime green can be repeated in interior details or left as the only color accent. The best background for the wood-effect base is light walls, neutral tile, or stone-effect surfaces.

The layout is L-shaped: 3.9 linear meters of furniture along two adjacent walls. Work surfaces, cabinets, and spaces for built-in appliances are distributed between two sections, and the corner is used too.

All the fronts are made of laminated chipboard: the upper row is light lime green, and the rest have a brown woodgrain decor. The wood texture comes from the panel’s surface finish — it is not solid wood.
The standard K-31 configuration includes a FREE FOLD Hafele lift-up mechanism for the wall cabinets: the front opens upward, and the contents are easy to reach.
Also included: a cargo pull-out for food and kitchen utensils, Muller Profi Line soft-close hinges for the hinged doors, Muller telescopic slides without soft-close for the drawers, and handles.
Color: Light lime green on top and brown wood on the lower section
Upper fronts: Laminated chipboard, light lime-green decor
Lower fronts: Laminated chipboard, brown woodgrain decor
Decor: Combination — light lime-green upper section and brown woodgrain fronts
Drawer slides: Muller telescopic, without soft-close
We adapt the K-31 to your kitchen, choosing the dimensions, shades, materials, hardware, and cabinet interiors together with you.
